title: Parity scan machine prefix invariant
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean string and let $j\le |x|$. After $j$ steps of the even-parity scan machine started on $x$, its state records whether the prefix of length $j$ contains an even number of true bits; its input-head position is $j+1$, and its output is empty.
